title: Gotrade Daily: Nvidia Hits a Record as Fed Hike Bets Fade
summary: Nvidia and the Nasdaq closed at records as Fed hike bets faded. Tonight's watchlist: NVDA, TSM, MSFT, MCD and STZ, which reports today.
body_markdown:
## Tonight's Watchlist


Stock Movement What to Watch


[NVDA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) +2.12% Monday at $238.90 Closed at a record high for the first time since May. Watch whether the gains hold with yields above 5%.


[TSM](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/tsm/) +2.75% Monday at $485.80 Touched intraday record highs after Elon Musk confirmed early Terafab talks. Watch for any update on the talks.


[MSFT](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/msft/) +1.48% Monday at $525.18 Melius Research said demand for AI security could lift Microsoft. Watch whether the gains hold.


[MCD](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/mcd/) +0.50% Monday at $233.04 Hit with a class action alleging AI-powered menu price-fixing. Watch the reaction to the lawsuit.


[STZ](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/stz/) +0.39% Monday at $113.31 Scheduled to report earnings today. Watch results against the $3.55 EPS and $2.54 billion revenue forecasts.


Source: closing prices from[StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/) . What to Watch:[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-monday-october-5-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-treasury-bond-081220790.html) (NVDA, TSM),[Yahoo Finance/The Fly](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/microsoft-upgraded-hubspot-initiated-wall-134952467.html) (MSFT),[Investing.com/Reuters](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/mcdonalds-hit-with-class-action-alleging-aipowered-menu-pricefixing-4932870) (MCD),[TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/calendars/earnings/2026-10-6) (STZ).


## Tonight's Key Events


### Nvidia leads the Nasdaq to a record


**Nvidia ([NVDA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) )** closed at an all-time high for the first time since May and led the Nasdaq Composite to a new record, according to[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-monday-october-5-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-treasury-bond-081220790.html) . In the same sector, **Taiwan Semiconductor ([TSM](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/tsm/) )** touched intraday record highs. Elon Musk called his talks with TSMC on the Terafab chip project "just discussions, but something may come of it."


### Microsoft and AI security


Melius Research said **Microsoft ([MSFT](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/msft/) )** and cybersecurity companies "are even more needed" as AI leaders speak of the risks of the technology, according to[The Fly via Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/microsoft-upgraded-hubspot-initiated-wall-134952467.html) .
